**Finding: compliant (INSURANCE)**

Section 18 of the Cobalt Cloud agreement already meets our preferred insurance position in full:

- **CGL** — USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§ 18.1)
- **Professional E&O** — USD 2,000,000 (§ 18.1)
- **Cyber and privacy liability** — USD 5,000,000, granted unconditionally rather than gated on a narrow data category, so it covers Vendor's processing of our data (§ 18.1)
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law (§ 18.1)
- **Certificates** — provided on request (§ 18.2)

Section 18.2 also adds terms that favour us (primary coverage over Customer's insurance where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities), plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 and a one-year tail beyond the term. No redline proposed.
